chain.title: Find the reactor fuel
chain.desc: Mine a supported yellorium source and collect the raw material. Extreme Reactors uses the bigreactors namespace in this version; it is a different project from Bigger Reactors.

chain.title: Refine the first fuel supply
chain.desc: Smelt raw yellorium into ingots. Check accepted fuel tags in the installed pack; another mod may offer compatible uranium, but the quest detects this verified yellorium item.

chain.title: Graphite for reactor components
chain.desc: Make graphite with the installed smelting recipe. Keep a reserve for reactor parts and later processing equipment.

chain.title: Configure reactor ports
chain.desc: Craft the mod's wrench for supported port and machine configuration. Read each port's mode before connecting automated input and waste removal.

chain.title: Frame a small basic reactor
chain.desc: Plan a complete Basic reactor using the in-game guide. Keep all parts in a compatible variant and include fuel rods, control rods, a controller, access port, and power connection.

chain.title: Arrange the fuel columns
chain.desc: Place fuel rods inside the valid reactor layout. Complete each column with the corresponding control rod as directed by the guide.

chain.title: Control the fuel reaction
chain.desc: Install control rods in their valid positions and review insertion settings. Start with a small reactor and observe its fuel use and heat behavior before expanding.

chain.title: Provide fuel and remove waste
chain.desc: Configure access ports for fuel insertion and waste extraction. Keep the waste route available so a full internal buffer does not stop the reactor unexpectedly.

chain.title: Connect the energy output
chain.desc: Install the suitable Forge Energy power tap and attach compatible extraction. The tap and external cable must both support the intended energy flow.

chain.title: Complete the first reactor controls
chain.desc: Add the controller and finish the valid structure. Inspect its interface, supply fuel, and test at modest settings before designing a larger power plant.

chain.title: Recover spent-fuel material
chain.desc: Operate the fueled reactor and collect cyanite from its waste output. Keep it for recycling and turbine components instead of allowing the access port to fill.

chain.title: Plan fuel recycling
chain.desc: Prepare the Reprocessor multiblock from the guide. Include its required controller and connections rather than expecting casing blocks alone to process waste.

chain.title: Run the recycling process
chain.desc: Complete and supply the Reprocessor according to its operating recipe. Check its fluid, item, and energy requirements before feeding the stored waste.

chain.title: A fuel recovered from waste
chain.desc: Collect Blutonium from the supported recycling process. Consult the reactor's accepted fuel configuration before inserting it into a particular reactor setup.

chain.title: A separate steam-power project
chain.desc: Plan the Basic turbine shell and its complete rotor, controller, fluid, and power connections. It needs a compatible steam source; the Basic reactor is not automatically a steam generator.

chain.title: Build the turbine's rotor
chain.desc: Assemble the shaft, bearing, and blades in the guide's permitted layout. Leave room for the induction coils and check the supported rotor dimensions.

chain.title: Match blades to the steam supply
chain.desc: Install turbine blades and choose an appropriate rotor size. More casing does not increase useful output without sufficient steam and a matching coil arrangement.

chain.title: Complete and monitor the turbine
chain.desc: Finish the turbine with its required ports, coil blocks, bearing, and power tap. Supply steam and manage the returned fluid; use the controller to tune operation.

chain.title: A reactor with more options
chain.desc: Prepare Reinforced reactor components as a separate, compatible structure. This variant supports options absent from the Basic reactor, including active cooling with the proper ports.

chain.title: Control the reinforced structure
chain.desc: Finish the reinforced reactor using matching rods, ports, and controller. Choose passive energy production or a complete active-cooling system deliberately.

chain.title: Route coolant and steam
chain.desc: Configure the appropriate fluid ports for a Reinforced actively cooled reactor. Provide coolant and a steam consumer with enough capacity before operating it in this mode.

chain.title: Recover the next reactor waste
chain.desc: Use Blutonium as an accepted reactor fuel and recover its Magentite waste. Keep the waste route separate from the fresh fuel supply and save material for advanced components.

chain.title: Plan fluid-fuel processing
chain.desc: Prepare the Fluidizer's structure using its guide. The required injector arrangement depends on whether it converts or mixes solid and fluid fuel sources.

chain.title: Run the selected fluidizer mode
chain.desc: Finish the Fluidizer and supply the exact recipe inputs. Check the permitted number and type of injectors for the chosen operating mode.

chain.title: Improve a turbine's coil material
chain.desc: Fluidize Cyanite, then use that fluid with Blutonium in the Reprocessor to make Ludicrite. Review the result's induction-coil use when tuning the turbine.

chain.title: A reinforced turbine project
chain.desc: Plan a Reinforced turbine with compatible rotor and supporting parts. It remains a steam consumer and does not require building every advanced material-processing machine first.

chain.title: Tune the larger steam consumer
chain.desc: Complete the turbine and connect sufficient steam, return-fluid handling, and energy output. Use observed rotor behavior to tune it rather than maximizing size immediately.

chain.title: Research advanced coil materials
chain.desc: Supply Magentite fluid and Ludicrite to the Reprocessor recipe for Ridiculite. Keep the fluid and solid ingredient lines separate as the advanced material chain expands.

chain.title: Locate the rare anglesite ingredient
chain.desc: Obtain Anglesite through the world-generation or recipe route available in the pack. Save the first crystals for advanced reactor-family components.

chain.title: Locate the rare benitoite ingredient
chain.desc: Obtain Benitoite from an available world or processing source. This exploration material is independent of completing every reactor and turbine variant.

chain.title: A component for energy storage
chain.desc: Craft the Energy Core with Anglesite, Magentite, and the remaining ingredients. It belongs to Extreme Reactors' Energizer components, not Draconic Evolution's separate storage system.

chain.title: Storage cells for the Energizer
chain.desc: Combine the Energy Core and Benitoite with the installed recipe's materials. These cells supply capacity within a correctly built Energizer energy-storage multiblock.

chain.title: Store the power your plant produces
chain.desc: Assemble the Energizer with its cells, casing, controller, and suitable energy connections. Test charging and extraction. This machine stores energy; advanced fuel materials are made in the Reprocessor.

chain.title: Reprocess Ridiculite with Rossinite
chain.desc: Obtain the required Rossinite fluid through the reactor-fuel pathway, then combine it with Ridiculite in the Reprocessor. Consult the full reactant chain before planning this optional material project.

chain.title: A separate Rossinite material recipe
chain.desc: Use Benitoite crystals and the required Rossinite fluid in the Reprocessor's Insanite recipe. Inanite is a parallel output, not a mandatory ingredient in this route.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. Every authored row now has explicit prerequisites; empty lists identify intentional branch roots. The coverage section states the verified versions and remaining limits. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
limits: Targets cached Extreme Reactors 1.20.1-2.0.84 under the actual bigreactors mod ID. Bigger Reactors is a separate mod and is not covered by this file.
Component acquisition does not prove a valid multiblock or a running fuel process.
The full advanced fluid-reactant production chain remains in the in-game guide; this milestone guide does not enumerate every fuel conversion.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
